name: sitar
description: Jewelbox 53 Sitar: a compact whole sitar lying along the paddle - the dark teak neck with ivory edge inlay, arched brass frets and steel strings is the striker and runs straight into the lacquered pumpkin gourd (tumba) with ivory rosette and bridge at the right; the small upper gourd hangs under the neck, tuning pegs below the left end.
